outcome: Transience vs. permanence of neonatal hyperthyrotropinemia
cohort: 76 infants diagnosed with hyperthyrotropinemia between 2002 and 2014
finding: The majority of infants with neonatal hyperthyrotropinemia had transient elevations, and male sex was associated with a higher likelihood of transient hyperthyrotropinemia.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery rates were higher in the group with transient congenital hypothyroidism compared to the group with permanent congenital hypothyroidism (86.7% vs 54.2%; P = .036).
